tells.1: Feature-label-plus-explanation bullets kept from a template with the persuasive lines removed, which leaves vague filler like 'adds more to the app'
tells.2: Vague 'unlocks additional features', and every bullet uses the same 'so you...' clause
tells.3: Stock marketing phrases such as 'guidance you can trust', 'keep your recovery moving' and 'unlock more of what the app has to offer'
tells.4: Slightly cliché closer, 'look back at how far you've come', under a generic 'BUILT FOR REAL RECOVERY' header

reason: Version 4 has a natural, warm voice with varied rhythm ('bouncing back', 'we'll give you a nudge') and stays clear and credible. Versions 1 and 2 are accurate but flat and vague about Premium, and version 3 relies on generic promotional language.
